units.source_text: 倘走陆路，则车辆太多，十分招摇。

en.t: If they went by land, there would be too many carriages and they would attract far too much attention.

units.source_text: 倘分为水陆两路，则又太麻烦。

en.t: If they split into separate land and water routes, that would be too troublesome as well.

units.source_text: 由于京中来使也非常注意避免人目，

en.t: Since the messenger from the capital was also very careful to avoid being seen,

units.source_text: 于是决定全部乘船，悄悄地前进。

en.t: they decided that everyone would travel by boat and proceed quietly.
